response: No, the analysis of the epidemiological pattern of Shigellosis in Barcelona between 1988 and 2012 does not indicate that it is an emerging sexually transmitted infection (STI) in the general population. However, there is evidence to suggest that Shigellosis may be an emerging STI among men who have sex with men (MSM), as outbreaks of Shigella infection have been reported among this group in several countries, including Barcelona. The epidemiological pattern of Shigellosis in Barcelona during this period was characterized by a significant increase in cases among MSM, particularly those with HIV infection, suggesting that Shigellosis may be a significant public health concern in this population.
